subject: CONFIRMED SOURCE GAP: cached visual authorization does not cross-fence keyguard/security state
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-security-rd-visual-security-authorization-20261002. CONFIRMED SOURCE: production main SnapshotCache retains per-panel bitmap+uptime for 15 minutes; PanelEngine instant-start can present that cached bitmap before a fresh capture; FoldOverlayService has no keyguard/screen-lock invalidation path and onAccessibilityEvent is Unit. Shizuku capture correctly returns null when shell marks containsSecureLayers, and Accessibility capture can fail for secure windows, but PanelEngine explicitly keeps an already-running stale bridge on capture failure. Therefore age/cycle/geometry validity is not equivalent to security authorization: a pre-lock/pre-security-context bitmap can remain eligible after the user-visible security context changes. This does NOT prove a Fold7 lock-screen exposure has occurred; physical overlay/keyguard ordering must be field-tested. Gen2/Gen3 direction: monotonic securityEpoch sampled from KeyguardManager state, exact capture-ticket epoch, fail-closed presentation while keyguard showing/device locked, and no old-frame resurrection after unlock.
